column1: # pgrust RC binary manifest — the trust anchor for update-binary.sh
# One row per publishable binary. update-binary.sh installs ONLY a binary whose
# sha256 matches a row here, so a tampered, truncated or simply wrong download
# cannot be installed silently. THE SHA256 IS THE TRUST ANCHOR AND IT IS
# PERMANENT; the URL is a convenience and may expire.
# Adding a row is how we publish a build. If the fix you are waiting for is not
# listed with a real sha256, it has not been published — do not accept a binary
# for it from any source, including us.
# Columns, TAB separated:
#   name         short handle you pass to update-binary.sh
#   sha256       the trust anchor. 'PENDING-NOT-YET-PUBLISHED' = refuse.
#   source_sha   pgrust-fast commit the binary was built from
#   status       current | superseded | pending
#   url          fetch URL, or '-' if none. MAY EXPIRE — see the note below.
#   notes        free text
# ON URLs: our artifact store is private, so URLs here were time-limited
# pre-signed links, issued directly to the auditor. They are redacted ('-')
# in this public copy: pass your own source with --from PATH or --url URL.
# The sha256 in this file still verifies whatever you fetch, so a missing
# link costs you a round trip, never your ability to check our work.
# name
rc1-pgo
column6: The originally preinstalled RC. dist-pgo. CRASHES on grouped MIN/MAX(text) at high repetition (GL-SINKCRASH-2). Superseded by rc1-sinkfix; kept so you can reproduce the crash and A/B against the fix.

column1: rc1-sinkfix
column6: The FROZEN RC, and the binary you should be measuring. Contains GL-SINKCRASH-1 + GL-SINKCRASH-2, which fix the grouped MIN/MAX(text) crash present in rc1-pgo. Built by fleet job pgrust-build-dist-pgo-1785174379-72ac-13953 with the SAME dist-pgo recipe as rc1-pgo (fresh PGO retrain, same corpus) so a cross-check against the superseded binary is apples-to-apples. 45,730,312 bytes, ELF aarch64.

column1: rc1-pmfix
column6: rc1-sinkfix + the postmaster busy-spin fix (cherry-pick 3409cb6162 of 04e2dd9ba3). Fixes a 100% CPU epoll_pwait(...,0) spin that engaged on EVERY server after 60s of uptime (the GL-GANGWEDGE stall-watchdog early-wake in DetermineSleepTime was not gated on shutdown-in-progress). Critical for perf measurement: the spin steals a core in the background. SAME dist-pgo recipe as rc1-sinkfix. Built by fleet job pgrust-build-dist-pgo-1785352055-59c5-98399. 45,795,848 bytes, ELF aarch64. URL redacted in the public copy; sha256 is the permanent anchor.
